title: QA Engineer : Manual, Automation & Salesforce
description:
What you’ll do

* Review requirements, user stories, and designs; identify gaps, edge cases, and

acceptance criteria.

* Plan and perform functional, regression, exploratory, integration, and user acceptance

testing.

* Build and maintain automated tests for critical user journeys across web and mobile.
* Test APIs and backend workflows, including request validation, responses, error

handling, and data consistency.

* Test Salesforce features and workflows, including record creation and updates,

permissions, automation, reports, and integrations.

* Validate end-to-end scenarios such as registration, profile and credential updates, job

search, applications, recruiter interactions, and status changes.

* Verify data flows between the product, Salesforce, and connected services; investigate

sync failures and duplicate or missing records.

* Track test cases, defects, and QA work in Jira; write clear, reproducible bug reports and

verify fixes.

* Collaborate with developers to reproduce issues and improve testability.
* Maintain test plans, test cases, automation suites, and release quality notes.
* Participate in release readiness reviews and help the team make risk-based testing

decisions.

* Consider accessibility, usability, privacy, and security in day-to-day testing.

What you’ll bring

* 3+ years of experience in software QA, including both manual and automation testing.
* Experience testing web applications and REST APIs.
* Hands-on experience with an automation framework such as Playwright, Cypress, or

Selenium.

* Experience with API testing tools such as Postman or equivalent.
* Salesforce testing experience, ideally with Sales Cloud or Service Cloud.
* Understanding of Salesforce objects, fields, relationships, profiles and permissions,

Flows, reports, and integration behavior.

* Practical experience using Jira to manage defects, test work, and project workflows.
* Ability to write clear test scenarios and communicate defects with useful steps, expected

results, and actual results.

* Familiarity with SQL or another method of validating application data.
* Understanding of the software development lifecycle, Agile practices, and CI/CD

workflows.

* Strong analytical skills and attention to detail, with the ability to prioritize testing based on

user and business impact.

Good to have

* Experience testing mobile applications or responsive web experiences.
* Experience with healthcare, recruiting, staffing, or job marketplace products.
* Familiarity with AI-enabled features, including conversational search and

recommendations.

* Experience with Salesforce integration testing, such as REST APIs, middleware, or

event-driven data flows.

* Familiarity with accessibility and cross-browser testing.

title: QA Tester
description:
**ABOUT THE ROLE**  
We are looking for a detail-oriented QA Engineer with 2+ years of hands-on experience in software testing. You will help ensure the quality, reliability, and usability of our applications by identifying issues early and working closely with developers and project teams to deliver dependable software.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Analyze business and technical requirements and identify testing needs.
* Prepare and execute test plans, test scenarios, test cases, and test data.
* Perform functional, regression, integration, system, and exploratory testing.
* Identify, document, prioritize, track, and verify defects through resolution.
* Collaborate with developers and project teams to investigate and resolve issues.
* Conduct UI, usability, and cross-browser testing where required.
* Participate in requirement discussions, sprint planning, and release activities.
* Maintain QA documentation, test reports, and release validation records.
* Recommend improvements to testing processes and overall product quality.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* 2+ years of professional experience in Software QA / Testing.
* Good understanding of SDLC, STLC, defect life cycle, and Agile/Scrum practices.
* Hands-on experience with functional and regression testing.
* Ability to design clear test cases, scenarios, and test data.
* Experience with defect tracking tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar.
* Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and problem-solving skills.
* Clear communication and effective collaboration with cross-functional teams.

**GOOD TO HAVE**

* API testing experience using Postman or similar tools.
* Basic knowledge of SQL and database testing.
* Exposure to automation tools such as Selenium, Cypress, or Playwright.
* Experience testing web or cloud applications; Salesforce/CRM experience is an advantage.
* Salesforce Admin Knowledge and Experience in Salesforce Testing will be a Plus!

**WHAT WE VALUE Ownership:** Take responsibility for quality and follow defects through resolution. Curiosity: Investigate issues and understand root causes.

**Collaboration:** Work constructively with developers, business analysts, and project teams

description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented **Automation QA Engineer** with **3+ years of experience in QA and at least 2 years in test automation** to ensure the delivery of reliable, high-quality software solutions. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with Playwright, TypeScript/JavaScript, API testing, and Azure DevOps, along with a proactive approach to identifying issues and improving test coverage.

* Develop and maintain CI/CD test pipelines using Azure DevOps.

* Investigate test failures, report bugs with clear documentation, and minimize flaky tests.
* Expand test coverage across negative scenarios, role-based access controls, and end-to-end workflows.

* Hands-on experience with Playwright using TypeScript or JavaScript.
* Experience with Cucumber and BDD (Gherkin syntax).
* Strong understanding of REST API testing.
* Experience with Azure DevOps pipelines and Azure Test Plans.
* Working knowledge of Git and Docker.

title: QA Engineer
description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for a detail-oriented QA Engineer to join our R&D Department. The candidate will be responsible for validating web-scraped data, reviewing sample files, testing API responses, verifying client-specific requirements, and ensuring that all deliverables meet defined quality standards before submission.

The candidate will work closely with developers, Team Leads (TLs), and Assistant Team Leads (ATLs) to identify defects, maintain quality benchmarks, and prevent recurring data extraction issues.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Data Quality Assurance**

* + Validate scraped data against the source website and client requirements.
  + Verify field-level accuracy, completeness, consistency, and data types.
  + Identify missing fields, incorrect values, duplicate records, and formatting issues.
  + Validate product details, pricing, availability, URLs, identifiers, and other relevant attributes.

**2. Sample and Deliverable Validation**

* + Review sample files before they are marked as QA-passed or submitted to clients.
  + Ensure that the output structure, column names, file naming conventions, and data formats match the specified requirements.
  + Validate samples against the approved requirements and reference examples.
  + Maintain evidence of validation and document any defects identified.

**3. API Testing**

* + Validate API requests and responses, including HTTP status codes, response structures, required fields, and error handling.
  + Verify JSON, CSV, Excel, and other required output formats.
  + Test pagination, filtering, and relevant request parameters wherever applicable.
  + Use Postman or similar tools for API validation.

**4. Defect Management and RCA**

* + Report defects with clear descriptions, sample records, screenshots, and reproduction steps.
  + Coordinate with developers and TLs/ATLs for defect resolution and retesting.
  + Identify recurring quality issues and contribute to Root Cause Analysis (RCA).
  + Maintain defect logs and track issues until closure.

**5. Quality Process Improvement**

* + Develop and maintain QA checklists for different projects and platforms.
  + Identify opportunities to automate repetitive validation tasks using Python.
  + Track quality metrics, including defect rates, first-pass acceptance, rework, and sample rejection trends.
  + Recommend improvements to reduce recurring errors and improve delivery reliability.

**Required Skills**

* + Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  + Experience in manual testing, data validation, or software QA.
  + Basic to intermediate Python knowledge for data validation and automation.
  + Experience working with JSON, CSV, Excel, and structured datasets.
  + Understanding of REST APIs, HTTP methods, status codes, and response validation.
  + Familiarity with Postman, Excel, and basic SQL/MongoDB queries.
  + Excellent attention to detail and documentation skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* + Experience in web scraping, crawling, e-commerce data, or data extraction projects.
  + Knowledge of HTML, CSS selectors, XPath, and browser developer tools.
  + Experience with automated testing frameworks or data comparison scripts.
  + Familiarity with Git and issue-tracking systems.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* + Accuracy and completeness of QA validation.
  + Number of defects identified before client submission.
  + Reduction in recurring defects and sample rejections.
  + Compliance with project-specific QA checklists.
  + Timely completion of QA reviews.
  + Quality and completeness of defect reports and RCAs.
  + Effectiveness of retesting and defect closure.

**Expected Outcome**

The QA Engineer will establish an independent quality checkpoint within the R&D workflow, ensuring that samples and deliverables are validated against client requirements before final approval and reducing avoidable rework and quality escalations.
